altTitles.ja: 婚約破棄の手続きはお済みですか？
婚約破棄の手続きはお済みですか？ 第二の人生を謳歌しようと思ったら、ギルドを立て直すことになりました

altTitles.ja-ro: Konyaku Haki no Tetsuzuki wa Osumi desu ka?: Daini no Jinsei wo Ouka Shiyou to Omottara, Guild wo Tatenaosu Koto ni narimashita

altTitles.en: You Want to Break off Our Engagement? Well, You'd Better Break the Bank!
Have You Completed the Procedures for Canceling Your Engagement?

altTitles.zh: 关于废除婚约的手续已经办好了吗？

description.en:
Her fiancé, Claude Reig, abruptly called off their engagement. However, Patricia succeeds in winning a large amount of compensation from Claude and succeeds in breaking off the engagement. She remembered the memories of her previous life, when she was called "Iron Chief" in her company. After leaving her hometown, Patricia found a new job at the "Raid Mercenaries Guild." But just as she was about to open the door, she heard a loud male yell...?

---
Patricia, daughter of Count Sainraime, was rather happy when her fiancé, Claude, told her he wanted to break off their engagement. She had already prepared perfectly for this day... all the documents that proved that she could receive a certain amount of money as compensation. Claude couldn't believe his eyes, for Patricia was a carefree girl in front of him for a long time. He didn't know that Patricia remembered her previous life as Akiko, an office worker, on her sixteenth birthday. There was no choice for him but to sign the documents.

With the money, Patricia bought her parents a second house and headed off to a town far away. She wanted to find a place to work. But when she found a job at a mercenary guild, it was a tough place...!
description.ja: 婚約者であるクロード・ライグから、突然婚約破棄を言い渡されたパトリシア・セインレイム。しかしパトリシアは、婚約を破棄するにおいて、自身が有利になるように十分な資料と証拠をそろえ、クロードから多額の賠償金を勝ち取ることに成功する。その姿は「以前のか弱いパトリシア」とはまるで別人だった。なぜなら彼女は16歳になった年に、「鉄の主任」と会社で呼ばれていた、前世の記憶を思い出していたから――。そして故郷を離れたパトリシアが見つけた新しい就職先は「レイド傭兵ギルド」。でもドアを開けようとした瞬間、聞こえてきたのは男性の大きな怒鳴り声で…？
